Calculation.Text: /* _ColorImageRGB ( pRed ; pGreen ; pBlue ) Dynamically creates an image (file) with the given color which can be output via a container field (as a stored or unstored calculation) to produce dynamic color. Set the following properties on the container field to get an edge to edge color: • container: enlarge/reduce • container: don't maintain proportions and (to remove the border) • field borders: ON • field border width: 0px • field border color: None The current version of the function creates a 16x16 pixel gif file with the name "color«rrggbb».gif". Parameters pRed - 0-255 pBreen - 0-255 pBlue - 0-255 Examples _ColorImageRGB ( 82 ; 71 ; 66 ) _ColorImageRGB ( 0 ; 0 ; RGB( 82 ; 71 ; 66 ) ) // If you already have an RGB value you can do this too 2025-03-26 @mrwatson-de Version 1.1.1 Simplified to make it faster 2020-05-11 RW: Version 1.1 STANDALONE version of the simplified RGB CF 2020-05-09 RW: Version 1.0 of the simplified RGB CF */ Case( IsEmpty( pRed ) and IsEmpty( pGreen ) and IsEmpty( pBlue ) ; "" ; Let( [ vRGB = pRed*256*256 + pGreen*256 + pBlue; vBL = Mod( vRGB ; 16 ); vRGB = Div( vRGB ; 16 ); vBH = Mod( vRGB ; 16 ); vRGB = Div( vRGB ; 16 ); vGL = Mod( vRGB ; 16 ); vRGB = Div( vRGB ; 16 ); vGH = Mod( vRGB ; 16 ); vRGB = Div( vRGB ; 16 ); vRL = Mod( vRGB ; 16 ); vRGB = Div( vRGB ; 16 ); vRH = Mod( vRGB ; 16 ); vRGB = Div( vRGB ; 16 ); vHEX = "0123456789ABCDEF" ; vRRGGBB = Middle( vHEX ; 1+vRH ; 1 ) & Middle( vHEX ; 1+vRL ; 1 ) & Middle( vHEX ; 1+vGH ; 1 ) & Middle( vHEX ; 1+vGL ; 1 ) & Middle( vHEX ; 1+vBH ; 1 ) & Middle( vHEX ; 1+vBL ; 1 ) ]; /* Create a gif File from the hex of a 16 x 16 pixel single color GIF image (where the RGB-bytes marked as #r#g#b) */ HexDecode ( Substitute( "47494638376110001000910000000000#r#g#bffffff00000021f904090a0003002c000000001000100000020e8c8fa9cbed0fa39cb4da8bb33e05003b" ; ["#r#g#b" ; vRRGGBB ] ) ; "color" & vRRGGBB & ".gif" ) ))
